description: Finds products like one found in a product search, from across the stores, leaving out that same product. It takes the product's id from a product search result, and an optional price ceiling. It returns products the same way a product search does, each with its price, whether it is in stock, an image and a link, and it collapses the same product sold by more than one store to one.

id.description: The id of the product, from a product search result.

limit.description: How many alternatives to return, from 1 to 10. The default is 5.

maxPrice.description: The most an alternative may cost, in the product's currency. Leave it out for no price limit.

name: find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to a product
